title: Execute Windows commands and desktop actions reliably, and retain a runnable managed agent after restart.
changes: Preserve quoted CMD executable paths, arguments and ampersands; use the correct switches for a configured PowerShell shell.
Discover Edge in Program Files (x86), and keep all generated Windows UI action scripts parseable when no numeric range value is supplied.
Clear the Windows clipboard through its native API, including empty writes, and honor ignored-file searches with ripgrep.
Read Windows clipboard text and PowerShell output as UTF-8 so Unicode names, clipboard contents and Chinese/Japanese/Cyrillic text are not corrupted.
Apply browser scroll requests immediately even when the page uses CSS smooth scrolling, instead of reporting success with an unchanged position.
Reject substituted screenshot source leaves using precise file identity checks; preserve existing filesystem confinement.
Restore the npm command shim from persisted Windows service module paths and defer remote policy-change restarts until the command can acknowledge completion.
Verify restart-helper handoff with a disposable Interactive/Limited Scheduled Task; make runtime command fixtures portable and test asynchronous compact terminal output correctly.
